verdict.rationale: Scheduling recurring jobs is a fair question for an AI app builder with hosted backends, but the evidence documents no scheduler, cron, or recurring trigger. The 'reusable set of instructions' for frequent workflows (docs-15) are on-demand instruction packages, not recurring schedules. The Payload backend and publishing docs do not mention scheduled jobs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
